metadata.description: Approved plugin marketplace for the AI-native SDLC: the sdlc plugin and the reusable workflows projects call.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: AI-native SDLC for any project and tech stack: Plan (write-intent), Design (write-spec, review-spec, design-ui), Build (build-story with Graphify and Ponytail, verifier), PR review (review-story), Test, Deploy (release), Maintain (triage), onboarding (init), guardrail hooks, and reusable GitHub workflows.
